references.text: The account of Aaron's death on Mount Hor, where he died at the age of 123, and his son Eleazar succeeded him as priest.
The previous verse describes how Aaron went up to Mount Hor by the Lord's command and died there in the fortieth year after the Exodus from Egypt.
Reference that the Israelites traveled from Beeroth-Bene-Jaakan to Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar became priest in his place.
Moses is told that he will die on the mountain he climbs, just as Aaron died on Mount Hor.
States Aaron's age when he and Moses spoke to Pharaoh—Moses was 80 years old and Aaron 83—which confirms Aaron's age at the time of the Exodus from Egypt.
